LanguageData.WotF_TerrainStride.label: terrain stride mantle
LanguageData.WotF_TerrainStride.description: A light woodland mantle. On passable cells that require no door opening, it removes movement penalties from terrain, plants, rock chunks, furniture, crossable workbenches, snow and sand. It does not allow passage through walls or impassable water, and doors still open normally.
LanguageData.WotF_EntropyCirclet.label: entropy circlet
LanguageData.WotF_EntropyCirclet.description: A circlet forged from elven steel, mithril or adamantine. It accelerates neural heat recovery and raises the wearer's safe neural heat limit.
